relationships.subject: cannabinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: exogenous cannabinoids can have anxiolytic, antiemetic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects

key_findings: Evidence-based prescribing of cannabinoids for symptomatic kidney failure is not currently possible
Cannabinoids are potential therapies for pruritus, nausea, insomnia, neuropathic pain, anorexia and restless legs in kidney failure
